protocol.window_pool: val[:300] + test[:200] of ETTh2 (same windows as the trained probe)
protocol.features: mean-pooled encoder output, standardized on probe-train
protocol.probe: Ridge; alpha by 5-fold CV (shuffle, random_state=0) on the PRETRAINED encoder's probe-train over logspace(-3,6,19); the same alpha is reused for every fine-tuned encoder
protocol.bootstrap: percentile, 10000 resamples of the 10 seeds, rng 12345
protocol.noise_floor: 20 independent target permutations per split, rng 777; floor = 95th percentile of |mean dR^2| over replicates
